I did not attribute the issues to my water until after traveling to two different locations. While away from my house and not drinking the water at my house, I did not experience any stomach or bowel issues. Once I replaced the water filter with a different brand, the stomach and bowel issues stopped.

If you're looking for a replacement water filter for your GE SmartWater, refrigerator filter, then the PUREPLUS MWF Replacement is an excellent choice. I had the opportunity to try this product myself, and I'm thoroughly impressed.

First and foremost, the installation process was incredibly easy. I'm not particularly handy, but I was able to replace my old filter with the PUREPLUS MWF Replacement in a matter of minutes. The instructions were clear and concise, and the filter fit perfectly into my fridge.

But it's not just the ease of installation that impressed me - the filter also looks great in my fridge. It has a high-quality look and feel, and it doesn't take up too much space. Plus, it's always nice to have a visual reminder that my water is being filtered and purified every time I open the fridge.

But of course, the most important aspect of any refrigerator filter is the quality of the water it produces. And in this regard, the PUREPLUS MWF Replacement does not disappoint. The water tastes fresh and clean, with no weird aftertaste or odor. I've been using this filter for a few weeks now, and I'm still amazed at how much better my water tastes compared to before.

This style works better than any other I've ever tried in my Keurigs. Every other type has ended up in the trash can after a couple uses because the coffee just tasted like week swamp water no matter what I did. I use DD coffee and the grinds for this particular coffee are hard on a kurig and do not brew well with other reusable cup types. I own one of these already and have had it for several years. I have been worried about what I was gonna do when or if it ever breaks because I have not seen these in the regular stores anywhere around me.  Then I came across this by chance on Amazon and was absolutely thrilled! I bought the two pack. Sure enough the are exactly the same as the one I already own. Makes a wonderfully tasty cup of DD coffee and my kurig does not constantly get clogged up or burnt out. Saves me a TON of money using this as opposed to buying the pre made K cups. Before I started using this particular reusable cup, I literally had to buy a new kurig machine at least once a year. And yes I cleaned it regularly, yes I rinsed it after every use. It's the DD grinds. They do not perform the same in a kurig as other coffees. My machine lumps would literally clog and burn up. I am proud to say that with this style reusable cup I have been on the same kurig machine without any major problems for over 3 years now! So yes, I highly recommend this product.
